_comment: Config for Module A06 (Start-frame + Veo video). VERIFY BEFORE FIRST PAID RUN: (1) the exact Veo model id available on this Gemini API key/project, (2) that billing on project ai-youtube-generator covers Veo, (3) the image-to-video request shape (the value below is a placeholder to confirm against the current Google GenAI docs at build time). tier 'fast' keeps per-second cost down; short-format only for now. 720p renders faster/cheaper and is upscaled to 1080x1920 at assemble.
